user.title: Connect to SmartThings
user.description: Choose how to sign in. Using the login of Home Assistant's SmartThings integration means no token to create or renew.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: SmartThings rejected the saved login. Choose how to sign in again.

reconfigure.title: Change login
reconfigure.description: Choose how this soundbar signs in to SmartThings.

smartthings.title: Use SmartThings integration login
smartthings.description: The soundbar will use the login of the official SmartThings integration, which renews itself. That integration must stay set up.

token.title: Personal access token
token.description: Create a token at {token_url} with the Devices scopes (list, see, control). New tokens may expire after 24 hours.

device.title: Choose your soundbar
device.description: Pick the soundbar to add. You can also paste a device ID.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Check it is correct, not expired, and has the Devices scopes.
error.no_devices: No devices were found for this token.

abort.smartthings_not_loaded: The SmartThings integration is not set up or not loaded.

data_description.max_volume: Soundbar volume level that Home Assistant treats as 100%.

yaml_missing_device_id.title: SmartThings Soundbar YAML is missing device_id
yaml_missing_device_id.description: Your `smartthings_soundbar` YAML entry has no `device_id`, so it could not be imported. Remove it from `configuration.yaml`, restart, and add the soundbar from Settings > Devices & services instead.
